title: Echoes of the Void
author: Commander T. Vance
description: Board a silent deep-space survey vessel trapped in decaying orbit around a volatile pulsar. Manage failing reactor power and life support to uncover the crew's fate.

scenes.title: Airlock Threshold
scenes.content: The outer pressure seal clamps shut with a metallic hiss. Amber emergency strobes illuminate a silent, zero-gravity corridor aboard the USS Starlight. Sparks shower from a severed power conduit. Ahead lies the Command Deck, while a service ladder descends to Engineering.

choices.text: Float along the main corridor toward the Command Deck
Descend the maintenance tube into the Reactor Bay

scenes.title: Command Access Corridor
scenes.content: The blast door leading to the Command Bridge is sealed behind an emergency bio-lockout. Floating beside an auxiliary terminal is an officer's jacket with an encrypted security keycard clipped to the collar.

choices.text: Head down to the Reactor Bay to inspect power reserves

scenes.title: Command Access Corridor (Access Granted)
scenes.content: The command keycard chimes softly as you align it with the bulkhead scanner. The heavy blast doors grind open, revealing the panoramic observation bridge.

choices.text: Check Reactor Bay status before initiating flight systems

scenes.title: Reactor Bay Core
scenes.content: The antimatter containment sphere hums with a deep, shuddering vibration. Diagnostic screens blink critically: 3 auxiliary power cells remain online. You can route power to stabilize Life Support or overload the Sub-light Thrusters.

choices.text: Route 1 power unit to restore Environmental Life Support
Siphon auxiliary plasma to supercharge the main engines (+2 Power Units)

scenes.title: Reactor Bay (Systems Routed)
scenes.content: Power relays clunk into their new configurations. Alarms warning of orbital decay intensify—the nearby pulsar's gravitational pull is increasing rapidly. You must reach the bridge immediately.

choices.text: Swipe your security keycard and enter the Command Bridge
Return to the corridor to find access credentials

scenes.title: Command Bridge
scenes.content: Through panoramic viewport glass, the blinding violet corona of the pulsar fills the horizon. The central navigation console displays three operational protocols awaiting your final authorization.

choices.text: Fire sub-light thrusters at maximum burn to break orbital decay
Lock into high orbit, seal life-support compartments, and transmit an emergency SOS beacon
Jettison the primary ship and launch the lone remaining hyper-pod

scenes.title: Escape Velocity
scenes.content: Engine arrays scream to life with immense thrust, tearing the USS Starlight out of the pulsar's gravitational well. As the ship reaches safe open space, you plot a triumphant course back to the Alliance frontier.

ending.title: Escape Velocity
ending.description: You overclocked the reactor and successfully piloted the starship out of the dying pulsar's grip.

scenes.title: Beacon in the Night
scenes.content: With life support purring steadily, your wide-band tachyonic distress signal reaches an Alliance patrol cutter. Within hours, magnetic docking clamps lock onto your airlock. The ship and its valuable survey data are saved.

ending.title: Rescue at Dawn
ending.description: You prioritized life support and maintained station stability until an Alliance rescue fleet arrived.

scenes.title: Castaway in the Void
scenes.content: The escape pod shoots into the cold expanse as the Starlight slips into the pulsar's gravity sink. Automated cryo-stasis needles hiss into your arm. You drift into a deep dreamless sleep, confident that someone will one day find your beacon.

ending.title: Castaway in the Void
ending.description: You survived the catastrophic orbital collapse, drifting safely in cryo-stasis.
